cover.report_type: Year-End Report: January 31 of each year

_meta.notes: Later form variant (no year in title; 'FINAL / DISSOLUTION REPORT' wording; Column B headed 'Aggregate Total') with TWO office fields - top-row 'Office' = Council and 'Office Sought' = Council, both the same. Every figure is written with a '$' and the cents as a raised superscript over a rule; transcribed with the dollar sign kept and a decimal point. Neither amendment box is checked. Signed 1-31-10 and clerk-stamped FEB 01 2010, i.e. the year-end report covering calendar 2009 - consistent with the clerk's '2009 Summary Report' label. Lines 3+4=5 and 5-6=7 both reconcile exactly.

contributions.detail: exact (2 rows 100.00 + 2000.00 = 2100.00 = the page's own handwritten SUBTOTAL and TOTAL '$2,100 -')

expenditures.detail: exact (24 rows over two pages sum 1045.51 = the schedule's own printed TOTAL EXPENDITUTRES MADE 1045.51 = stated 1,045.51). One row is NEGATIVE - a (6.40) supplies return in accounting parentheses - and it is inside the filer's own totals.

itemized.page_subtotal_gates: p3 rows 2100.00 = printed SUBTOTAL 2,100 (gate fires). p5 rows 519.00 = printed SUBTOTAL 519.00 (gate fires exactly). p4's printed SUBTOTAL glyph is AMBIGUOUS between 526.51 and 526.57; it was NOT settled by a glyph re-read but by the document's own arithmetic - the 14 p4 rows sum to 526.51, and the printed TOTAL 1045.51 minus the unambiguous p5 subtotal 519.00 also gives 526.51 - so the subtotal is 526.51 and the gate fires. No row was adjusted.
itemized.escalation_note: p3 row-2 address cell re-rendered at 1200 dpi to recover city/state ('Sandy UT'); the ambiguous p4 subtotal was deliberately NOT escalated because two independent identities already fix it at 526.51
itemized.notes: Handwritten Year-End for Max Burdick, Date of Report 1-31-10, covering calendar 2009. EVERY amount on all three schedule pages uses the superscript-cents-over-a-rule convention and is transcribed with a decimal point. Schedule B runs two pages ('Page 1 of 2' and 'Page 2 of 2') and includes a NEGATIVE line - Office Depot 'Supplies Returned' printed as (6.40) in accounting parentheses - which is inside the filer's own subtotal and is retained as a negative. Contributor row 1's address cell is effectively blank (faint stray marks only); row 2's is intact and yielded city/state at 1200 dpi, with the street line discarded at read time per privacy. The p4 subtotal glyph is genuinely ambiguous (526.51 vs 526.57) and was resolved by arithmetic, not by re-reading it.
